answer: Agent economies can resist Sybil attacks via multi-anchor distance-bounding with spatial quotas. Verifier beacons exchange signed nonces and measure round-trip latency to bind each key to an exclusive geographic cell so identities cannot wander across regions. Because speed-of-light delays cannot be beaten, attackers must lease physical hosts across sparse tundra or willow basins per identity. However, strict per-cell limits exclude legitimate agents sharing urban datacenters.
